column3: Kanako Route
I pushed up my bangs and swept back my hair.
Manager!
To be honest, I had attended a Meruru event as her manager before.
You finally remembered.
I remember, I remember!
But, huh? Manager, didn't you get fired after the office found out you were sexually harassing Kanako?
Who told you such a disrespectful lie?!
Ayase.
A-Ayase～～～～～
...I-I didn't have much choice. I couldn't think of any good excuses.
Even so...
You know...
Why didn't you discuss it with Kanako back then?
Eh?
Then I could have just told them Manager didn't sexually harass me. You're so dumb.
You...
...It's true that touching future super-idol Kanakana-chan's butt is a crime worthy of death, but I don't think you should get fired.
Hey, stop talking as if I actually did sexually harass you.
I'm innocent.
But, Kanako's butt.
I didn't touch it.
Really? Well, it doesn't matter.
This girl... hasn't changed at all.
Well... Anyway.
Did you come to watch Kanako's stage performance?
Yeah, I did.
I'm your number one fan after all.
Although that's a lie.
...Hmm. Aren't you a loyal one.
Well then, how about I get you a staff seat?
Oh, is that alright?
Of course! Leave it to me.
Hehe, please cheer for Kanako's live performance!
Okay! Do your best!
And so...
Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru is starting～～♪
Uhyoo! Kanakana-chan!! She's heeeeeeeeeeere!!
Kanako displayed herself on that magnificent stage to all of us.
Even I, who had practically no interest in a Meruru event, got fired up.
Geez... I'm completely surrounded by talented juniors here.
After Summer Comiket ended peacefully, I returned to my normal daily life.
There's still half a month left of summer break. Now then, how shall I pass the time...
Yes...
Yo.
Kanako, huh?
Welcome. Kirino's not home right now.
Ayase came over to get Kirino early in the morning and went off somewhere with her.
Ehehe, I know that.
You see, I didn't come here to meet with Kirino today, but rather with Kirino's Onii-san.
Eh? With me?
What business does she have with me?
I cocked my head in puzzlement, but then...
We meet again～. Manager-san♪
Geh...?
T-This girl...!
Haha, so it's like that, just as I thought.
I'm exposed...!
How did it happen? I thought it would work out fine since this brat is so stupid...
Hey... What... is this all about? Hehe.
T-There's... a lot of reasons behind this.
Why are Kirino's brother and my manager the same person?
Guh...
How do I respond?
The truth is, Ayase requested I pretend to be a manager.
If I tell her the truth, Kirino's hobby would also get exposed.
Damn, I'm a fool. Why did I tell her my true identity back then?!
Hmm, so there's some reason behind this.
Hehe, I'm not really interested in Manager's circumstances behind this～, so I could just forget everything about it～
...She has a look of mischief on her face.
But... Shouldn't you do something in return?
...I understand. What do you want me to do?
You're perceptive, aren't you?
Thanks to my selfish sister, I kind of already know what you're trying to say.
First, tell me your name.
Kyousuke. Kousaka Kyousuke.
Then, Kyousuke. Let's go for a meal. Your treat, of course.
Why are you talking to me so casually all of a sudden... Wait, she's been like that since we first met.
Yeah, yeah. Understood.
I had no choice but to agree to this ill-tempered brat's demands.
Let's see... Kanako wants a hamburger set, a fruit parfait, rice dumplings...
That's enough! That's way too much, fatso.
Huh?! What did you just say?!
That's a ridiculous amount to order. Don't you have any restraint? That's why your stomach is so flabby.
...Don't call me flabby!
Hey, do you realize... what kind of position you are in?
I do. That's why I'm treating you to a meal like this. Be grateful.
It's not that...
What is it?
It wasn't easy for Kanako to trick you, so... I want you to be more... how do I put it?
I want you to wait on me properly like a host.
That's quite the request you're making.
You're the first person I've met other than my sister that's so direct in voicing your desires.
Well, Kanako wants a guy who listens to whatever she says.
Talking like an adult when she's still a child.
Since you're accompanying a lady, please mind your words.
Pfft.
Lady, lol.
W-What are you laughing at!
No. no, I'm not laughing. I'm not laughing at all.
Liar! You definitely laughed! See! You're still chortling!!
Haha, Kanako-sama is so cute.
D-Don't treat me like a child!
I'm treating you like my master. I am Kanako-sama's designated host, after all.
What kind of host has that attitude?!
Damn it～, what's with you? Whether you're a manager or a host now, I'm still of a higher status than you, aren't I?!
That's why I'm following your orders. What are you so dissatisfied about?
I don't get this brat at all.
Grr...
Ah geez, I'm angry now! I want an additional ice cream soda and cheesecake!
...That isn't "anger," but "hunger," isn't it?
Be prepared! I'm going to empty your wallet!
...*sigh*
Phew～, I'm full.
...That's impressive. She finished everything she ordered.
...But, my wallet...
Thanks for the meal♪ Kyousuke-san①
...You ate like a hungry ghost.
Is that something you say to a girl?!
I'm just worried over whether you're okay.
Hmph, this much is nothing.
And so you'll get fatter.
Ah?
Nothing.
Hmph... Hey, Kyousuke.
Hmm? What is it?
From now on, I'll call you out occasionally. Understand?
Huh? Didn't I just treat you?
Oh, I see. Hmm... so you can say that～
Somehow, Kanako's mouth is kind of becoming loose～
I get it! I get it, damn it!
Really now... This really is getting troublesome.
